definitions.control: Actual post-step VehicleControl readback only; absent terminating readback is counted and excluded, never filled with a requested action.
definitions.cruise: Active transitions after the startup exclusion and more than five metres from own goal; blocked transitions are excluded from efficiency, not safety or overspeed.
definitions.first_motion: Stationary starts only: accumulated unblocked elapsed time until measured speed first reaches 0.5 m/s; rolling starts are not scored as fast startup.
definitions.lateral: Absolute distance to road reference lane, including own terminating transition; never distance to whichever lane happens to be nearest.
definitions.qualification: Every vehicle and every registered stratum must pass; aggregate joint arrival alone cannot qualify.
definitions.scope: Known training screens and validation selected models must remain labelled separately; neither grants held-out or population-level generalization.
definitions.symmetry: Physical template and numbered mirror are grouped together; no constraint on simultaneous arrival or arrival gap.
definitions.unblocked: Explicit diagnostic pace_front_blocker_exempt is false; no missing diagnostic is interpreted as clear road.

contract.purpose: Per-vehicle engineering qualification and validation selection; this is not a legal speed limit or a generalization claim.

scenario_pool_manifest.evaluation_scope: same-corridor engineering validation of new combinations; not formal heldout/generalization evidence
scenario_pool_manifest.initial_speed_semantics: requested physical speed at first policy observation, committed by existing environment velocity warm-start/readback; not an ongoing target controller
scenario_pool_manifest.legacy_r8a_12: unchanged separate regression evaluation, excluded from this pool and its sampling
scenario_pool_manifest.split_rule: whole actor-swap physical-template groups; validation uses +/-4m offsets absent from training's 0/+/-8m
